cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you get your train, could you taste this soup? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll fix that. You'll need to check again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train leaves in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. That's when the bread comes out.

mechanism: A confidently manages preparations while adapting every reason for lingering to B preferences, sustaining company without directly asking B to stay.
confusable: Distinguish issuing a stay order from offering tasks or experiences whose continuation depends on keeping B willing.
comparison: Soup quality offers repeated checks against a train deadline; packing jam offers revisions and tasting after B rejects carrying it.
seedUse: Canonical soup/jam seeds supply indirect delay; S02 shift/rowing seeds inform face-saving adjustment to B terms rather than merely adding voluntary please.
